metadata.scope: Official HRM quarterly financial reports used for conservative summary-table extraction
metadata.known_gap: 2024/25 Q1 remains explicitly missing from the checked series.
metadata.latest_research_result: Targeted official HRM and eSCRIBE research on September 11, 2026 did not verify a 2025/26 Q4/year-end report. The prior 2024/25 year-end/Q4 report was tabled in September 2025, so no absence conclusion is drawn before a current authoritative source is located or the comparable reporting window passes.
metadata.note: These are quarterly financial-report sources. They are not accounts-payable, invoice, vendor-payment or transaction-ledger sources. Missing quarters remain explicit rather than inferred.
